messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Sure! Here’s a quick rundown of the major public‑holiday long weekends that occurred in Canada during 2023 (dates are based on the federal statutory holidays; some provinces may observe additional holidays):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Typical Long Weekend |
|---------|-------------|----------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Jan 1–3 (New Year’s Eve & New Year’s Day) |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Feb 18–20 (Family Day) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Apr 7–10 (Good Friday & Easter Monday) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | May 20–22 (Victoria Day) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Jul 1–3 (Canada Day) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Sep 2–4 (Labour Day) |
| Thanksgiving (Ontario, PEI, NL, NB, QC) | Oct 9 (Monday) | Oct 7–9 (Thanksgiving) |
| Remembrance Day (some provinces) | Nov 11 (Wednesday) | Nov 11–13 (Remembrance Day) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Dec 23–25 (Christmas) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Dec 26–28 (Boxing Day) |

**Notes**

* **Family Day** is observed in British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, and New Brunswick.  
* **Remembrance Day** is a statutory holiday in several provinces (e.g., Ontario, Quebec, Manitoba, etc.) but not in all.  
* Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.) that could create extra long weekends.

If you’d like a more detailed, province‑specific list or want to include provincial holidays, let me know and I can tailor the data accordingly!
